headline: Aurelian Central Bank holds rates steady, signals patience on inflation
subheadline: Policymakers kept the benchmark rate at 3.25% for a fourth consecutive meeting.
description: The Aurelian Central Bank left its benchmark interest rate unchanged at 3.25% for a fourth consecutive meeting, saying it needs more evidence that services inflation is easing.
author: j-okafor

image.caption: A historic central bank building (file photo). Policymakers held rates for a fourth consecutive meeting.

seo.title: Aurelian Central Bank holds rates at 3.25%, signals patience
seo.description: Aurelia's central bank holds its benchmark rate at 3.25% for a fourth meeting, wanting more evidence that services inflation is easing.

body: AURELIA CITY — The Aurelian Central Bank left its benchmark rate unchanged at 3.25% on Wednesday, as widely expected, and gave little indication that cuts are imminent.
In its statement the bank said headline inflation had fallen to 2.6% but that services prices were still rising at an annual rate above 4%, driven by wages and rents.

Officials pointed to a tight labour market and a rebound in housing costs as reasons to hold. Two members of the nine-person committee voted for a quarter-point cut, one more than at the previous meeting.

body.text: We would rather be criticised for being late than for being wrong.

body: Markets now price the first cut for March 2027. Mortgage lenders said fixed-rate products were unlikely to fall meaningfully before then, a point seized on by opposition politicians campaigning on housing costs ahead of regional elections.
The bank's next decision is due on 10 December.
